coauthors: Y. Puranik, M. Kılınç (CMU); T. Li, A. Gopalakrishnan, B. Besançon, T. Roba (Air Liquide)

quotes.text: The resulting advances include development of a regression‐based fully‐deterministic nonconvex optimization model, a tool for diagnosing infeasibilities during model development, reformulations and scaling to make the model more amenable for optimization, and development of strengthened relaxations for its efficient solution.
